# compelem-i18n

> An i18n plugin for CompElem — reactive translations for web components with ICU pluralization and locale fallback.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md) - Installation, usage, and API reference
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/holyhigh2/compelem-i18n) - Source code and issues

## Features

- Reactive `t()` — components re-render automatically on locale change
- `{name}` interpolation with dot-path parameter access
- ICU pluralization via `Intl.PluralRules`
- Locale fallback chain: locale → language subtag → fallbackLocale → key
- `d()` / `n()` localized date/number formatting
- Lazy loading with `mergeLocaleMessage()`
- TypeScript key autocompletion

## Quick Start

```ts
import { CompElem, tag, h } from 'compelem'
import { createI18n } from 'compelem-i18n'

const i18n = createI18n({
  locale: 'zh-CN',
  fallbackLocale: 'en',
  messages: {
    'zh-CN': { hello: '你好，{name}！' },
    en: { hello: 'Hello, {name}!' },
  },
})

@tag('my-comp')
class MyComp extends CompElem {
  render() {
    return h`<p>${i18n.t('hello', { name: 'Ken' })}</p>`
  }
}
```

## API

### createI18n(options)
Create an i18n instance.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locale` | `string` | `navigator.language` | Current locale |
| `fallbackLocale` | `string` | — | Fallback locale |
| `messages` | `Record<string, LocaleMessages>` | required | Message tables per locale |
| `datetimeFormats` | `Record<string, Record<string, Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions>>` | — | Named date formats |
| `numberFormats` | `Record<string, Record<string, Intl.NumberFormatOptions>>` | — | Named number formats |
| `syncDocumentLang` | `boolean` | `true` | Sync `<html lang>` on switch |

### Instance Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `t(key, params?)` | Translate with interpolation/pluralization |
| `d(date, formatKey?)` | Localized date formatting |
| `n(value, formatKey?)` | Localized number formatting |
| `setLocale(locale)` | Switch locale |
| `mergeLocaleMessage(locale, messages)` | Lazy-load messages |
| `onLocaleChange(cbk)` | Listen for locale changes |
